runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 11:55 sweep. Eleven independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public career pages, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress Jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new offer met fit, freshness and evidence threshold for safe LIVE promotion. Fresh Brigada.sk receptionist role in Bratislava was excluded because it requires communicative English and is primarily student-oriented. Upwork surfaced several WooCommerce operational roles, but the relevant ones were 2-4 weeks old, already hired/high-competition, underpriced, or demanded expert development/security skills. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Marketplace hire-state decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Reduce priority sharply when a freelance listing already has a hire plus multiple interviews, even if the listing remains technically open; this prevents wasting proposal time on effectively filled work.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Student-contract eligibility gate
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Separate roles merely suitable for students from roles legally restricted to student agreements; suppress only the latter when the candidate cannot use that contract, avoiding false rejection of ordinary part-time work.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data was attempted.
